answers.assumption_check: Load-bearing: git stash/checkout replace a tracked file by writing a new inode at the path (measured: inode replaced True on this box, ext4). An in-place truncate would keep the inode; the after-write check then sees the same file, and the line was written into it, so it is either there or overwritten by git's own bytes afterwards, which no lock can prevent. The dedupe on re-append uses the entry id (sha of the entry), which is unique per line.
